scope: Current tracked tree and prepared package filenames; high-confidence credential pattern screen; not history-wide or formal penetration test
absolutePathsDisposition: Existing historical evidence/diagnostic provenance may include reference-host origins; runtime cache isolation is tested separately. Do not claim every source/debug artifact has no path string.
fixedPasswords: Known ephemeral test fixture password temporary-test-only; not product credential. Tokens/SDP held in memory in new lab harness; no raw sensor histories/frames persisted.
physicalCaptureWrites: See final preflight/soak syscall audit aggregate; no stored images/video
sourceArchivePolicy: Supplier source/notice archives preserved; not runtime-captured data
review: Manual review of new harness operator/token flow, credential-free reports, bounded clock arrays and owned-process cleanup
